notes.fact: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say they sent drones at a US radar at Isa Air Base in Bahrain; Bahrain's state TV says air defences stopped them.
notes.event: Iranian drone attacks on US radar in Bahrain

notes.fact: No independent source has confirmed the Tuesday attack damaged the radar, Gulf News reports; it counts three claimed attacks on US radars in Bahrain in five days.
notes.event: Iranian drone attacks on US radar in Bahrain

notes.fact: US Central Command said it shot down two Iranian drones on Nov 13 with no damage or injuries, rejecting the IRGC's claim of a radar hit.
notes.key: claim:us centcom party in this war
notes.event: Iranian drone attacks on US radar in Bahrain

notes.fact: AP reports the Bahrain strikes end a roughly two-month pause in Iranian attacks on Gulf neighbours; Iran says it is answering US strikes and drone flights.
notes.event: Iranian drone attacks on US radar in Bahrain

notes.fact: Israel's Ynet says the latest IRGC claim came a day after Bahrain jailed dozens of Shiite clerics, 15 years to life, for alleged coup plotting.
notes.event: Iranian drone attacks on US radar in Bahrain

notes.fact: The US Embassy in Bahrain's Nov 16 alert cited heightened threats from Iran-backed Houthis and reported Iranian efforts to target US officials and facilities in the region.
notes.key: claim:us state department embassy party in this war
notes.event: Iranian drone attacks on US radar in Bahrain
notes.claim_by: official:US State Department/Embassy (party in this war)

notes.fact: Iran's Guard navy says mines have damaged six tankers since Sunday on a US-backed route; UKMTO separately reports a projectile hit a tanker, no casualties.
notes.event: Strait of Hormuz mines and tanker hits

notes.fact: AP reports USS Theodore Roosevelt has entered the Middle East, giving the US three carriers there while Trump keeps strike options open.
notes.event: Third US carrier arrives

notes.fact: Gulf News says the US and Israel are reportedly planning strikes on Iran's economic targets, and Iran says it will not wait for a US attack.
notes.event: US-Israel strike planning and talks

notes.fact: CNN, citing seven US officials, says new intelligence shows Iran drafting plans for a dirty bomb or chemical attack on officials in Washington; officials dispute whether Iran can carry it out.
notes.event: Reported Iranian plot against officials in Washington

notes.fact: Sources told CNN the planning looks like Iran giving itself options, not an imminent attack; the White House says there are 'no credible threats to the homeland'.
notes.event: Reported Iranian plot against officials in Washington

notes.fact: The Jerusalem Post reports the CNN story and stresses that sources saw no sign of an imminent attack; it has not been publicly confirmed by US agencies.
notes.event: Reported Iranian plot against officials in Washington

notes.fact: Pakistan's Express Tribune and Arab News relay the CNN report, noting officials are split on Iran's capability and that no decision to attack has been reported.
notes.event: Reported Iranian plot against officials in Washington

notes.fact: Arab News headlines it as a 'possible' plot and notes CNN found no evidence Tehran has chosen to proceed.
notes.event: Reported Iranian plot against officials in Washington

notes.fact: Crimea's Russian-installed head Sergey Aksyonov confirmed an attack on the bridge and limited traffic; the Kremlin's spokesman called the damage minor.
notes.key: claim:russian installed crimean authorities and kremlin
notes.event: Kerch (Crimean) bridge strikes

notes.fact: CNN reports a section of the bridge collapsed after a second Ukrainian strike in two days; Russia's transport ministry says traffic is suspended with no casualties.
notes.event: Kerch (Crimean) bridge strikes

notes.fact: Maritime Executive says a Ukrainian statement claims the road span was destroyed by missiles and drones; the outlet has no independent confirmation of the extent.
notes.key: claim:ukraine sbu general staff as quoted
notes.event: Kerch (Crimean) bridge strikes

notes.fact: Kyiv's mayor says Russian strikes hit the North and South bridges over the Dnipro, partly damaging the metro and causing water and power cuts.
notes.event: Russian strikes on Kyiv bridges

notes.fact: France 24 reports the strikes came as Russia hit Cherkasy and Kharkiv regions too; Zelensky had warned of Russian strikes planned for Monday evening through Tuesday.
notes.event: Russian strikes on Kyiv bridges

notes.fact: Zelensky says intelligence shows North Korea supplying Russia with new ballistic missiles; the EU also sanctioned 30 people and two entities over Russian disinformation and cyber operations.
notes.event: Talks and diplomacy

notes.fact: Saudi Arabia replaced its Yemen coalition commander a day after the Houthis advanced to about 60 km from Aden, The New Arab reports.
notes.event: Houthi advance and coalition command change

notes.fact: Yemeni military sources told Reuters the Houthis reached Khor Omeira, about 100 km west of Aden, within 25 km of government positions at Qa'wa.
notes.event: Houthi advance and coalition command change

notes.fact: Al Jazeera says government forces left the Bab al-Mandeb area to defend Aden; Saudi oil exports have been using that route while Hormuz is restricted.
notes.event: Houthi advance and coalition command change

notes.fact: AFRICOM says it struck al-Shabaab near Leego, about 114 km northwest of Mogadishu, on Nov 12, in coordination with Somalia's government; its release lists earlier strikes on Nov 5 and Oct 23.
notes.key: claim:africom us forces are a party
notes.event: US strikes in Somalia

notes.fact: South Korea's Joint Chiefs say several Russian military aircraft briefly entered its air defence zone over the East Sea without notice; jets scrambled, no airspace violation.
notes.key: claim:south korea joint chiefs not a party to a fight with russia
notes.event: Russian aircraft enter South Korean air zone
notes.claim_by: official:South Korea's Joint Chiefs (not a party to a fight with Russia)

notes.fact: The Korea Times notes Russia and China reject Seoul's air zone, and the last similar Russian entry was about three months ago.
notes.event: Russian aircraft enter South Korean air zone

notes.fact: Kyiv Independent, citing Yonhap, links the incident to deepening Russia-North Korea military cooperation, including North Korean troops and weapons for Russia's war.
notes.event: Russian aircraft enter South Korean air zone

notes.fact: Monadnock Community Hospital in New Hampshire confirmed its week-long server outage is a cyber incident; ambulances are diverted and some elective surgeries are cancelled through Nov 23.
notes.event: Monadnock hospital cyber incident

notes.fact: CISA, FBI, HHS, USDA and DOT published a fact sheet warning of ongoing attacks on industrial refrigeration and cold-chain controllers; steps include removing controllers from the internet and changing default passwords.
notes.event: CISA/FBI refrigeration advisory

notes.fact: SC World says the advisory rests on suspected attacks on European supermarkets, three French blood banks and up to six US military commissaries; similar equipment is used in US grocery stores.
notes.event: CISA/FBI refrigeration advisory

notes.fact: France's blood service EFS confirmed a supplier incident altered temperature and defrost settings at three facilities storing blood products, BleepingComputer reports.
notes.event: French blood bank refrigeration incident

notes.fact: Chase, Microsoft, FAA and United outages over about five days were each attributed by the firms to technical faults; none has reported evidence of a cyberattack.
notes.hotspot: cyber: new: US tech outages Nov 12-16
notes.event: Chase, Microsoft, FAA, United outages

notes.fact: Fox 7 Austin says Microsoft blamed elevated load after servers went offline; the FAA traced data flooding to two sites, one where L3Harris had installed a router.
notes.hotspot: cyber: new: US tech outages Nov 12-16
notes.event: Chase, Microsoft, FAA, United outages

notes.fact: A secondary summary says FBI-linked warnings cite water utilities in at least seven states reporting incidents since July 27, involving Rockwell MicroLogix controllers; I could not check the primary advisory.
notes.event: US water and industrial controller warnings

notes.fact: CISA's home page lists four Siemens industrial-control advisories on Nov 12 and two new known-exploited vulnerabilities added on Nov 13.
notes.event: CISA advisory stream

notes.fact: CISA's advisory on China-based Integrity Tech says linked actors hit edge devices across government, manufacturing and healthcare; the page also lists a related pro-Russia hacktivist advisory dated Nov 9.
notes.event: CISA/NSA Integrity Tech advisory
